_law: SHRINK-ONLY ON ONE CORPUS. One row per drawn pool: the ceiling for the share of its most-printed line (top1) and of its five most-printed lines (top5) over the corpus `corpus` names (scripts/census/pool-dominance.mjs). On that corpus a ceiling is only ever lowered (--tighten); a row leaves only when its pool is no longer drawn. A change of corpus is a change of instrument: the rows are re-based at the new corpus's measure through --rebase, on a chair's ruling, and never by hand. Held by tests/lint/poolDominance.walker.test.js.
